what_human_must_do: Pass KYC in your own name (legal step, agent cannot). Then finish the steps in apply/.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the MegaETH token page Go to the MegaETH token page and read the KPI Rewards section, which covers the conditions, maturity and the KPI list.
2 Step 2 : Hold MEGA in your wallet KPI Rewards go to holders who commit MEGA, so you need MEGA in the wallet you plan to commit from.
3 Step 3 : Commit your MEGA Use the Commit Now button in the KPI Rewards section of the MegaETH token page to commit your tokens.

4 Step 4 : Stay committed through attestations Keep your MEGA committed without interruption ahead of each KPI attestation. Maturity climbs every second toward 100%, and a longer commitment earns a larger share.
5 Step 5 : Claim and re-commit rewards After a distribution, collect the MEGA allotted to your position. You may commit the new tokens as well.
